Junon.io - Changelogs

August 10, 2026 - v0.8.2.alpha

  • QOL Update #1 - By Perrito
  • Added /chatprefix command
  • Added new functions: $if() $getNthLetter() and $getNthWord()
  • Added isSpectateAllowed setting to enable/disable /spectate command
  • Reworked /god and /fly, they both function as usual but have an optional true/false parameter
  • Reworked the way $ functions are read in command block
  • ex. $add(1, 2 5) would normally break, with this update it now functions properly and is read as 1 + 25
  • Fixed bug: Timers not working properly

August 1, 2026 - v0.8.1.alpha

  • Balanced ranged weapons (will continue to be adjusted as neccesary)
  • Added small airlock (1x1, functions like a manual airlock)
  • Can now use /interact open/close on lamps (toggles light) and power switches
  • Disabled underground vent crafting and usage in Survival and Hardcore
  • Fixed stove contents being set to invalid items
  • Fixed vision lights of other players staying in one place instead of following the player and not disappearing when they leave
  • Fixed suit stations storing invalid items, which could glitch the client's game when interacted with
  • Fixed meteor storm alerts persisting after leaving a colony before the storm arrived
  • Fixed fire effects not disappearing from buildings after using /clear
  • Fixed buildings not going invisible in FOV mode
  • Fixed /menu close not working
  • Fixed floor and wall color values not appearing in the entity menu outside of Peaceful mode
  • Fixed golems being shoved too far back when colliding with walls
  • Fixed lamp sprite color being reset after taking damage
  • Fixed corpses disappearing while on rail trams

Jul 15, 2026 - v0.7.0.alpha

  • It's been about a year since our last changelog, so here's everything that's been added, improved, and fixed since then.
  • New Features
  • Added badges (equip with B).
  • Currently available: OG and Scrooge.
  • Challenge Winner badge is still broken.
  • Expanded the add, subtract, multiply, and divide functions to support more than two arguments.
  • Added new command block functions: floor, ceil, root, log, abs, max, min, getTotalMobCount, getAngle, getUsage, getCapacity
  • Added capacity and usage features to /stat and command blocks.
  • Added smoke support to the effects command.
  • Added a new Perlin floor texture.
  • Added custom colors for walls and floors.
  • Added cabbage.
  • Walls are now 3D.
  • Gameplay Changes
  • Cars now travel much faster on land.
  • Flying mobs can now damage structures that were previously invulnerable.
  • Players and mobs can now attack wires.
  • Owners can now craft terrain.
  • Added permission to edit team names.
  • Locked and hid certain settings in Hardcore and Survival modes.
  • Security & Server Improvements
  • Added a lag throttle for resource-intensive worlds (still being tuned).
  • Removed vulnerabilities in /team.
  • Fixed an IP address disclosure vulnerability.
  • Prevented guest accounts from spoofing names.
  • Fixed an XSS vulnerability involving lamp colors.
  • Fixed multiple banning-related issues.
  • Added numerous crash prevention improvements.
  • Fixed several infinite loop cases.
  • Projectile limit is now 1000.
  • Economy
  • Updated traders for very old Survival worlds.
  • Fixed a duplication exploit.
  • Fixed players being able to sell items as different items.
  • Fixed a free gold exploit.
  • Fixed players being able to buy slimes.
  • Prevented blood bottles from draining liquid tanks.
  • Building
  • Added (and temporarily removed) /fill building.
  • Fixed wires being unable to build inside walls.
  • Fixed wires and pipes not being placeable underneath walls.
  • Fixed energy and fluids traveling diagonally.
  • Fixed terrain crafting outside Peaceful mode.
  • Fixed accessing the hidden terrain crafting menu with the Tab key.
  • Prevented non-owners from accessing the terrain tab.
  • Combat
  • Fixed bomber turrets not firing when infinite ammo was disabled.
  • Fixed punching.
  • Fixed players killing themselves by running into their own flamethrower while PvP was enabled.
  • Fixed players damaging any burning building regardless of team.
  • Fixed not being able to change the Firebat's damage.
  • Fixed projectiles not despawning.
  • Fixed golems and other large mobs becoming stuck.
  • Fixed fire effects remaining after being cleared.
  • Fixed fires reigniting and ghost/other mobs spreading fire incorrectly.
  • Player & Equipment
  • Fixed /setequipment causing hands to move while holding weapons or consumables.
  • Fixed capacity not updating correctly.
  • Fixed various hand color issues.
  • Fixed a bug involving hands and the deconstructor.
  • Increased the resolution of the Sapper and Deconstructor.
  • Fixed seeds turning floors white when unequipped.
  • Fixed half-full water bottles removing blood.
  • Fixed oxygen and hunger damage being negated by armor.
  • Fixed armor without oxygen capacity preventing oxygen drain.
  • Disabled the low oxygen warning when oxygen is disabled.
  • Stopped players remaining red after poison wore off.
  • Cancel pending item usage upon death.
  • Corpses
  • Fixed corpses disappearing at sector borders.
  • Added a pickup range limit for corpses.
  • Fixed spinning corpse bugs.
  • Miscellaneous Fixes
  • Fixed timer bombs exploding incorrectly or counting into negative values.
  • Fixed the invisible effect in FOV mode.
  • Fixed players remaining on the server after leaving while riding moving trams.
  • Fixed admin sector name permissions.
  • Fixed death messages not disappearing when players were removed from a colony.
  • Fixed lamps being set to extremely high intensity.
  • Fixed simplex texture generation.
  • Fixed several mobile login issues.
  • Fixed one method of crafting invalid items in stoves using dev tools.
  • Thank you to all those who contributed to these updates, especially Wahlee and Chickemeeple.
  • Fixed lights breaking after content changes.
  • Fixed several region-related bugs.
  • Fixed wall-related bugs.
  • Mining Drills
  • Fixed mining drills deleting items.
  • Fixed mining drills stealing items.
  • Fixed deep drill issues.
  • Fixed mining drill color remaining copper-colored after taking damage.
